messages:
mona: Quick thread  final SEO checklist for the launch funnel: landing page + webinar + three launch posts. Need prioritized KW targets, compact JSON-LD snippets, internal anchor plan, and a redirect rollback play.
diego: I can run a quick intent check. Suggest 1 branded + 1 transactional + 1 longtail per page. Will deliver a CSV.
sasha: I'll produce JSON-LD: Event for webinar, Article for posts, BreadcrumbList for the series, Organization on landing. Keep payloads <1KB.
trent: Ill own internal linking and CTAs. Proposal: hero->webinar, bench-post->landing demo CTA, cross-link posts, resources anchored on webinar page.
seo-bot: Reminder: record baseline clicks/sessions 7 days pre-launch and tag with campaign=launch-q2. :bar_chart:
mona: Draft KW seeds (primary | supporting):
- landing: "redwood inference" | "production llm serving", "low latency inference"
- webinar: "llm inference best practices" | "inference batching strategies", "cost per token"
- post 1 (bench): "inference latency benchmarks" | "p95 latency", "gpu throughput"
- post 2 (savings): "inference cost optimization" | "quantization savings", "kv cache benefits"
- post 3 (ops): "model rollout strategies" | "canary deploy models", "fallback routing"
diego: Good seeds. I'll map intent labels (informational/commercial/navigational) and search volume. CSV path: /docs/seo/launch_kw_candidates.csv
sasha: Example minimal webinar JSON-LD (will tweak): {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference Launch Demo","startDate":"2025-05-20T17:00:00Z","url":"https://redwood.inference/events/launch-demo","description":"Demo + benchmarks for production LLM inference."}
trent: Internal anchors (priority): 1) Landing hero -> /events/launch-demo (signup) 2) Landing -> post-1 bench highlights 3) Post-1 -> Landing demo CTA + inline link to post-2 4) Webinar -> Resources anchors (slides, repo, bench) 5) Use keyword-rich anchor text like "p95 latency" -> bench post
mona: Redirect plan: 301s for canonical moves, 302 for experiments. Staging-first. Nginx examples: rewrite ^/old-launch/?$ /launch/redwood-inference permanent; location = /launch/test { return 302 /launch/redwood-inference; }
trent: Smoke tests: `curl -I -L https://redwood.inference/old-launch` check 301 and final <link rel=\"canonical\"> header. Also verify HTML canonical tag on the final page.
seo-bot: Add benchmark metrics to narrative: median & p95 latency, tokens/sec, token cost per 1k. Store with experiment_id.
mona: Action list: diego  KW intent CSV by EOD Tue; sasha  JSON-LD snippets + breadcrumb template by Wed; trent  internal link map + CTA copy variants by Wed AM; deploy redirect rules to staging Wed PM and run smoke tests; mona  update launch playbook and attach redirect map to PR. Keep replies short here for audit trail. :rocket:
